installation.method: System apt-get via pkexec after user confirmation

method: System-installed application and dependencies with an isolated test profile. A temporary Qt observer/controller exercised the actual docks and Help update action; no replacement application modules or update implementations were used. User authorized Twitch in the normal browser.
limits: No chat messages were sent and no stream metadata was changed.
Update lookup and current-version handling were tested; no subsequent version was available to test an in-app package upgrade.
Firefox/Snap emitted mount-namespace and browser diagnostics to inherited stderr; these were separate from Penguin Studio logs.
Live GUI tests cover Ubuntu GNOME Wayland, not every supported distribution or compositor.
The test application was closed after verification; Twitch tokens are session-only.
